other_conditions: Total family income less than Rs.10,000 per month in rural areas and Rs.12,000 per month in urban areas
Total land holding less than 3 acres of wet land or 10 acres of dry land or 10 acres total
No family member should be a government employee or pensioner (sanitary workers are exempt)
Family should not own a four‑wheeler (excluding taxis, tractors and autos)
Monthly electricity consumption of the dwelling unit should be less than 300 units
No family member should be an income‑tax payee
Built‑up area should be less than 750 sq ft
Applicant must be a permanent resident of Andhra Pradesh
benefits_summary: ₹45,000 paid in three annual installments of ₹15,000 over three years.
